subject: Post-demo: model fit recap, recommended trials & parity thresholds
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@lumenhealth.com>, Tom Becker <tbecker@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: model fit recap, recommended trials & parity thresholds

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we keep momentum: 

1) What we heard
- Primary goal: extract structured insights from patient intake notes (entity extraction + normalization) and generate short clinician summaries.
- Success metric: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your clinical QA set and summary ROUGE-L comparable to your current proprietary baseline. Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 220ms for <256 tokens.

2) Immediate risks / concerns
- Hallucination sensitivity on rare entities — noted in sample 12 and 19 from your dataset.
- Privacy: you flagged PHI redaction requirements and audit logs for every inference.

3) Redwood proposal (trial phase)
- Recommended trial models: Open Llama 3 13B (q4_0), Mistral-Instruct 7B, and Redwood-Base-8K (our quantized 8-bit variant). See attached candidate_models_summary.pdf for pros/cons.
- Acceptance thresholds: set parity gates vs your proprietary baseline for entity F1 (target >= 0.92 of baseline) and clinician-summary ROUGE-L (>= 0.95 of baseline). If open models breach these gates we go forward with a larger pilot.
- Evaluation plan: we’ll run a 2-week blind eval on 1k withheld notes you provide; deliver benchmark spreadsheet + error slice analysis.

4) Security/compliance: please share the filled security questionnaire (you can attach the Lumen doc) and we’ll provision a VPC trial if needed.

5) Next actions (proposed)
- Sara: confirm dataset transfer method (S3 or secure upload) and confirm any redaction you want before we ingest.
- Tom: confirm decision-maker for procurement (PO vs contract).
- Marissa/Priyom: run baseline parity experiment and share a tentative timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: lumen_demo_recording.mp4, candidate_models_summary.pdf, prompt_set_v1.txt

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0192

From: Sara Li <sara.li@lumenhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tbecker@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model fit recap, recommended trials & parity thresholds

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the concise write-up — very helpful. A couple quick clarifications: 

- We’d prefer S3 with a short-lived role for upload. I’ll share access details once Tom confirms.
- On PHI: we need redaction by default for SSNs and full dates before Redwood sees the data, but we can allow the de-identified notes for quality evals. Can you confirm the trial flow supports pre-ingest redaction?
- We attached our security questionnaire and a short section with our procurement timeline — we aim to decide on a pilot vendor by July 1.

Also: do you expect the open models to require connective prompt engineering to reach parity, or are you expecting model-level changes (quantization/finetune)? We’re trying to understand effort vs vendor cost.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Li
Head of Data Science, LumenHealth
[Attachment: lumen_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@lumenhealth.com>, Tom Becker <tbecker@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model fit recap, recommended trials & parity thresholds

Hi team — jumping in with a proposed technical plan and artifacts we’ll run during the 2-week blinded evaluation: 

Technical plan (short):
- Stage A (baseline runs, 48h): run Lumen sample through your proprietary baseline (we’ll ingest the metrics you provide) and run the three candidate open models. Produce per-slice F1, precision/recall, hallucination flag rate, and latency percentiles.
- Stage B (prompt engineering, 3 days): systematic prompt sweeps on Open Llama 3 13B and Mistral-Inst 7B using the attached prompt_set_v1.txt (10 canonical prompts + 20 negative examples).
- Stage C (quantization + small-llm finetune check, 4 days): try 4-bit and 8-bit quantized variants; quick adapter finetune on 200 labeled examples if we’re within 5% of parity after prompts.

Acceptance thresholds (conservative):
- Entity extraction: open model must hit >= 0.90 of your proprietary baseline F1 to progress to pilot; >= 0.95 to be considered parity-ready.
- Summary quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.92 of baseline for a pilot; >= 0.98 for parity.
- Latency: 95p <= 250ms for our dedicated trial endpoints (we can adjust throughput to meet SLO).

Quality regression concerns:
- We’ll track hallucination rate per entity type (rare_medical_code, free_text_symptom). If hallucination increases >2x versus baseline on critical entities we block promoting the model.
- We’ll also run rollback tests to ensure no regression on your high-severity slices from last quarter.

Artifacts we’ll deliver: parity-benchmarks-20270605.csv (initial comparison), error_slices.md, and a short Loom walkthrough of findings.

Permissions and asks from Lumen:
- Sara: permission to run quantized variants on de-identified data (we’ll record and share logs).
- Tom: pointer to the procurement contact and whether a short pilot contract (30 days, capped usage) is acceptable.

I’ll spin up the baseline runs this afternoon — target to share a first-pass benchmark by Monday (2027-06-07).

Attachments: parity-benchmarks-20270605.csv, prompt_set_v1.txt

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Applied ML Lead, Model Fit & Evals | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

- Sara: once you send S3 credentials (short-lived role) we’ll start ingestion and baseline runs — please send by EOD tomorrow to hit our Monday benchmark target.
- Marissa: proceed with Stage A now; Priyom to own quantization checks in Stage C.
- Tom: noted procurement timeline (decision by July 1). I’ll send a 30-day pilot contract template and an NDA DocuSign link for signature this afternoon.

Proposed milestone calendar: 
- 2027-06-07: Baseline runs started by Redwood.

- 2027-06-16: Pilot kickoff (if gates met + contract signed).

If anyone needs an alternate cadence, flag here. I’ll also add a shared calendar invite for the 06/09 readout.

Best,
Evelyn
